title: Boş zaman
canDo: Hobilerim ve boş zaman etkinliklerim hakkında konuşurken fiilden sonra -ing ya da to + fiil kullanmayı doğru seçebilir, edat + -ing yapısını ve amaç bildiren to'yu kullanabilir, remember / stop / try fiillerinin iki anlamını ayırt edebilirim.
grammar: -ing (gerund) özne olarak ve like / enjoy / mind sonrası
amaç bildiren to ve sıfat + to
remember / stop / try + -ing ya da to

liveClass.title: Hobi kulübü
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler hayali bir "hobi kulübü" kurar. Sonunda herkes hangi kulübe katılmaya karar verdiğini ve nedenini I've decided to... çünkü I enjoy... ile açıklar.

lessons.title: Yapmayı severim
lessons.goal: Sevdiğim ve sevmediğim etkinlikleri -ing ile anlatabilir, -ing'i cümle öznesi olarak kullanabilirim.

learn.explanation:
**-ing (gerund)**, fiili bir **isim gibi** kullanmamızı sağlar.

**1. Bazı fiillerden sonra -ing gelir:**

| Fiil | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **enjoy** | I enjoy **cooking**. |
| **like / love / hate** | I love **reading**. |
| **don't mind** | I don't mind **waiting**. |
| **can't stand** | I can't stand **getting** up early. |
| **finish** | Have you finished **eating**? |
| **give up** | She gave up **smoking**. |
| **spend (time)** | I spend hours **reading**. |

(like / love / hate'ten sonra **to + fiil** de olabilir: I like **to read**. İkisi de doğru.)

**2. -ing cümlenin öznesi olabilir:**

- **Running** gives me energy.
- **Learning** a language takes time.
- **Swimming** is good for your back.

Özne olarak kullanılan -ing **tekil** sayılır: Swimming **is** ... (~~are~~)

examples.en: I enjoy spending time with my family.
Cooking for friends is my favourite thing.
examples.tr: Arkadaşlara yemek yapmak en sevdiğim şey.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "koşmak bana enerji veriyor" derken mastar (-mak) kullanırız. İngilizcede bunun karşılığı "to run" değil, çoğunlukla -ing'dir: Running gives me energy. "I enjoy to cook" da yaygın bir hatadır; enjoy'dan sonra her zaman -ing gelir.

lessons.title: Yapmaya karar verdim
lessons.goal: want, decide, hope, plan, learn gibi fiillerden sonra to + fiil kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Yeni yıl kararları
discover.body:
We asked our readers about their plans for this year.

"I've decided to learn the guitar. I've always wanted to play in a band." – Emre, 24

"I'm hoping to run my first half marathon in April. I need to train more!" – Hilal, 31

"Last year I promised to spend less time on my phone, but I didn't manage to do it. This year I'm planning to try again." – Cansu, 19

"My wife and I would like to visit Japan. We're saving up, but we can't afford to go yet." – Hasan, 45

"I've agreed to teach chess to the children in my building. They're learning to play really quickly!" – Nevin, 68

questions.prompt: What has Emre decided to do?
What didn't Cansu manage to do last year?
options: Spend less time on her phone
questions.explanation: "I promised to spend less time on my phone, but I didn't manage to do it."

learn.explanation:
Bazı fiillerden sonra **to + yalın fiil (infinitive)** gelir. Bu fiiller çoğunlukla **gelecek, plan, istek ve karar** anlatır.

| Fiil | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **want** | I want **to learn** the guitar. |
| **would like** | We'd like **to visit** Japan. |
| **decide** | I've decided **to join** a gym. |
| **hope** | I'm hoping **to run** a marathon. |
| **plan** | They're planning **to move**. |
| **need** | I need **to train** more. |
| **learn** | They're learning **to play** chess. |
| **promise** | He promised **to call**. |
| **agree / refuse** | She agreed **to help**. He refused **to come**. |
| **manage** | I managed **to finish**. |
| **afford** | We can't afford **to go**. |
| **try** | Try **to relax**. |

**Olumsuz:** **not to** + fiil → I decided **not to go**.

examples.en: I've decided to take up swimming.
She refused to lend me her car.
We decided not to go out because of the rain.
examples.tr: Yağmur yüzünden dışarı çıkmamaya karar verdik.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "gitmemeye karar verdim" derken olumsuzluk fiile eklenir. İngilizcede "not" to'dan önce gelir: I decided not to go (~~I decided to not go~~ günlük dilde duyulsa da). "I didn't decide to go" ise farklı bir anlama gelir: Gitmeye ben karar vermedim.

learn.explanation:
**Edatlardan (in, at, of, on, about, for, before, after, without...) sonra fiil gelirse -ing olur.**

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| be **good at** | She's good at **drawing**. |
| be **interested in** | I'm interested in **learning** Italian. |
| be **keen on** | He's keen on **cycling**. |
| be **fond of** | My aunt is fond of **knitting**. |
| be **tired of** | I'm tired of **waiting**. |
| be **afraid of** | She's afraid of **flying**. |
| **think about** | I'm thinking about **joining** a club. |
| **instead of** | Let's walk instead of **driving**. |
| **before / after** | Before **starting**, read the rules. |
| **without** | He left without **saying** goodbye. |
| **How about** | How about **going** to the cinema? |

**Dikkat: look forward to**'daki **to** bir edattır, bu yüzden -ing gelir:

- I'm looking forward to **seeing** you. (~~to see~~)

examples.en: I'm thinking about taking up tennis.
He's afraid of swimming in the sea.
How about having a picnic on Sunday?

learn.turkishNote: "Seni görmeyi dört gözle bekliyorum" cümlesi için "I'm looking forward to see you" demek Türkçe konuşanların en sık yaptığı hatalardan biridir. look forward to'dan sonra her zaman -ing gelir: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

lessons.title: Ne için?
lessons.goal: Amaç bildirmek için to kullanabilir, sıfat + to + fiil yapısıyla etkinlikleri değerlendirebilirim.

discover.title: Neden satranç?
discover.body:
Chess is one of the oldest board games in the world, and millions of people play it to train their brains.

Is it difficult to learn? Not really. It's easy to learn the rules, but it's hard to become a good player. Many people use apps to practise, and some join clubs to meet other players.

It's important to start slowly. Play against friends first, and don't be afraid of losing. It's normal to lose a lot at the beginning.

The best thing about chess? It's cheap to play. All you need is a board, and you can play it anywhere: in a park, on a train or online.

questions.prompt: Why do many people play chess, according to the text?

questions.explanation: "it's hard to become a good player"

learn.explanation:
**1. Amaç bildiren to** (= in order to, "-mek için")

- I go to the gym **to keep** fit.
- She uses apps **to practise**.
- **Why** do you go there? – **To meet** friends.

**Dikkat:** Amaç için ~~for + fiil~~ kullanılmaz:

- I went to the shop **to buy** bread. (~~for buy~~ / ~~for buying~~)
- Ama **for + isim** olur: I went to the shop **for** bread.

**2. It's + sıfat + to + fiil** (… yapmak … dır)

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| It's **easy to** ... | It's easy to learn the rules. |
| It's **hard / difficult to** ... | It's hard to become a good player. |
| It's **important to** ... | It's important to start slowly. |
| It's **cheap / expensive to** ... | It's cheap to play. |
| It's **fun / boring to** ... | It's fun to play with friends. |

**Kişiyle:** It's difficult **for me to** wake up early.

lessons.goal: remember, stop ve try fiillerinin -ing ve to ile değişen anlamlarını kullanabilirim.

learn.explanation:
Bazı fiillerden sonra hem **-ing** hem **to** gelebilir, ama **anlam değişir**:

| Fiil | + to | + -ing |
|---|---|---|
| **remember** | yapmayı **unutmamak** (önce hatırla, sonra yap) | yaptığını **hatırlamak** (anı) |
| | Remember **to bring** water. | I remember **cycling** here as a child. |
| **forget** | yapmayı **unutmak** | yaptığını **unutmak** (çoğunlukla "I'll never forget") |
| | I forgot **to lock** the door. | I'll never forget **meeting** her. |
| **stop** | bir şey **yapmak için durmak** | bir şeyi **yapmayı bırakmak** |
| | We stopped **to have** a rest. | Stop **eating** chocolate! |
| **try** | **çabalamak** (zor bir şey) | **denemek** (çözüm olarak) |
| | I tried **to fix** it, but I couldn't. | Try **putting** some oil on it. |

**İpucu:** remember / forget + **to** → gelecekteki görev; + **-ing** → geçmişteki anı.

I'll never forget seeing the sea for the first time.

task.prompt: Bir forumda "En sevdiğim boş zaman etkinliği" konulu bir gönderi yazın (130–160 kelime). task.modelAnswer:
My favourite free-time activity is photography. I took it up three years ago after I found my grandfather's old camera. I remember taking my first photo with it. It was a picture of a cat on a wall, and it was terrible!

I enjoy walking around the city to find interesting people and places. I'm especially interested in taking photos of old buildings. I can't stand using filters; I prefer natural colours.

Last year I decided to join a photography club to learn from other people, and it was the best decision.

If you want to start, here's my advice. It's easy to take photos with your phone, so you don't need an expensive camera. It's important to practise every day. Try looking at the light before you take a photo. And remember to stop worrying about perfect photos. Just have fun!

questions.modelAnswer:
Hi Selin,

Guess what? I've taken up rock climbing! I decided to try it after I watched a documentary about it. I wanted to do something different, because I was tired of sitting at home every evening.

There's a climbing centre near my office, and I go there twice a week to practise. At first I was afraid of falling, but the instructors are great. It's not difficult to learn the basics, and it's a fantastic way to get fit. I really enjoy solving the routes; it's like a puzzle!

Why don't you come with me next Thursday? You don't need to buy anything, because you can rent shoes there. Remember to wear comfortable clothes. I'm sure you'll love it.

I'm looking forward to hearing from you!

Love,
Duygu
